sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, json, zipfile, os
j=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('https://pypi.org/pypi/pip/json', timeout=30))
wheel=next(u for u in j['urls'] if u['filename'].endswith('.whl') and 'py3-none-any' in u['filename'])
print('downloading', wheel['filename'])
data=urllib.request.urlopen(wheel['url'], timeout=60).read()
open('/tmp/pip.whl','wb').write(data)
os.makedirs('/workspace/pylib', exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile('/tmp/pip.whl') as z: z.extractall('/workspace/pylib')
print('pip extracted')
PY
PYTHONPATH=/workspace/pylib python3 -m pip install --target /workspace/pylib -q rdflib && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/pylib python3 - <<'PY'

q=open('/workspace/solution.sparql').read()
for row in g.query(q):
    print(row)
PY
EOF
